PURPOSE: Define deterministic, independently reproducible source-enumeration, authority-reconciliation, active-build and deployment-evidence requirement roots without using source enumeration as build authority.

AUTHORITY_MODEL.BUILD_AUTHORITY: FINAL authoritative DOC-C only; DOC-B may constrain interpretation and DOC-D may support design only when incorporated by final DOC-C normative authority.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORITY: FINAL DOC-E deployment/runtime proof obligations remain a separate denominator and cannot create or satisfy build obligations.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.NEGATIVE_OBLIGATIONS: Final DOC-C MUST_NOT/non-goal requirements are active PROHIBIT obligations and are never dropped merely because a matrix row labels them excluded/current-negative.
AUTHORITY_MODEL.HISTORICAL_RULE: Pre-FINAL or source-label-only material cannot become active build authority without explicit final DOC-C normative incorporation.

PRIMARY_SPEC.LOGICAL_FILENAME: แอป [NEXY-IGNIS] ที่กำลังพัฒนา.docx

MATRIX_EXPORT.FORMAT: UTF-8 parsed-text export containing CSV sheets

CANONICALIZATION.LINE_ENDINGS: LF for text materialization controlled by this schema
CANONICALIZATION.ROOT_SELF_REFERENCE: Root hash is stored outside its root object and never included in itself.
CANONICALIZATION.HASH_OBJECT_EXTRA_KEYS: FORBIDDEN. Every authoritative hash object is projected to exactly the declared fields before JCS.
CANONICALIZATION.ARRAY_ORDER: Every array has an explicit order rule. Set-like arrays are deduplicated by exact canonical element JCS then sorted by the declared tuple.
CANONICALIZATION.NULL_RULE: Nullable fields are present with JSON null; omission is invalid unless the exact field schema says optional.
CANONICALIZATION.INTEGER_RULE: Integers are JSON integers only; fractional, stringified, NaN or infinite forms are invalid.
CANONICALIZATION.HASH_COLLISION_RULE: If the same derived ID/hash resolves to two non-identical canonical identity objects, status is HASH_COLLISION_BLOCKING. Never suffix, truncate further, or choose one.

PARAGRAPH_INDEX_CONTRACT.AUTHORITY_COMPARISON_RULE: All temporal/authority comparisons use transformed one-based primary DOCX paragraph numbers.

MATRIX_NORMALIZATION.CSV_PARSER: RFC4180-compatible quoting; doubled quote escapes; quoted commas/newlines preserved.
MATRIX_NORMALIZATION.BUILD_MATRIX_EXTRACTION: Read only the first sheet named Build Matrix from MATRIX_EXPORT, from its exact header through the row before the next <PARSED TEXT FOR SHEET marker.
MATRIX_NORMALIZATION.STRING_RULE: Decode CSV cell, normalize Unicode NFC, preserve non-empty content exactly including leading/trailing whitespace; do not semantic-trim.
MATRIX_NORMALIZATION.EMPTY_CELL_RULE: Empty decoded CSV cell becomes JSON null.
MATRIX_NORMALIZATION.ENTRY_SORT_RULE: Matrix rows sort by source_entry_id UTF-8 bytes; duplicate source_entry_id is invalid.

PRIMARY_REF.SORT: doc_class UTF-8 bytes, paragraph_1_based ascending, anchor_or_null null-first then UTF-8 bytes

TYPES.source_identity: lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA or lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 according to evidence_kind

TYPES.criterion_text: non-empty NFC string; immutable once manifest generation is adopted
TYPES.provenance_refs: non-empty sorted array of PRIMARY_REF or CONTROL_EVIDENCE_REF canonical objects

ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION.ID_CONTEXT_RULE: target_authority_key, spec_artifact_hash, source_entry_id and scope are taken from the exact bound acceptance-manifest row/root context; they are not copied from free text.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION.DEDUP_AND_ORDER: Within one source_entry_id+scope row, exact duplicate {criterion_text,provenance_refs} canonical objects are invalid as duplicate authoring input; after validation, criteria sort by criterion_id UTF-8 bytes. criterion_id collision with unequal canonical identity objects is HASH_COLLISION_BLOCKING.

IDENTITY_CONSTRUCTION.MATRIX_SOURCE_ENTRY_ID: Use exact normalized Build Matrix ID cell as source_entry_id. Empty, malformed or duplicate IDs are blocking.

PRIMARY_OMISSION_SOURCE_ENTRY_ID.SPLIT_MERGE_RULE: Clause segmentation is owned by the independently reviewed FINAL_DOC_C_NORMATIVE_CLAUSE_MANIFEST. One clause_id yields exactly one omission source entry when not already covered by a matrix source entry. Split/merge requires a new clause-manifest generation; IDs are never silently reused.

ACTIVE_OBLIGATION_ID.ONE_PER_SOURCE_ENTRY: Exactly one active denominator obligation per active reconciliation source_entry_id. Engineering tasks may subdivide implementation, but denominator identity does not.

DEPLOYMENT_OBLIGATION_ID.ONE_PER_SOURCE_ENTRY: Exactly one deployment denominator obligation per DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_ONLY reconciliation source_entry_id.

FINAL_DOC_C_NORMATIVE_CLAUSE_MANIFEST.PURPOSE: Provide a reviewed semantic denominator of final DOC-C atomic normative clauses so source-coverage zero is mechanically reproducible rather than inferred from a row count.

CLAUSE_ROW_TYPES.clause_text: non-empty NFC exact reviewed clause text

FINAL_DOC_C_NORMATIVE_CLAUSE_MANIFEST.SEGMENTATION_AUTHORITY: Clause segmentation/disposition is semantic and therefore must be independently reviewed against the pinned spec. It is not inferred by a generic NLP rule during root generation.
CONSISTENCY: BUILD_OBLIGATION requires polarity REQUIRE or PROHIBIT.
Rows sort by paragraph_1_based ascending then clause_ordinal_in_paragraph ascending.
FINAL_DOC_C_NORMATIVE_CLAUSE_MANIFEST.ADOPTION_RULE: Only one reviewed manifest generation may be canonical for one mission generation/spec generation. Competing candidate generations do not confer authority.

FINAL_DOC_C_COVERAGE_MANIFEST.PURPOSE: Bind every reviewed final DOC-C clause to matrix/omission source entries or an explicit non-obligation disposition and derive zero unmatched mechanically.

ROOT_FIELD_TYPES.row_count: non-negative integer equal canonical clause row count and rows.length
ROOT_FIELD_TYPES.unmatched_count: non-negative integer mechanically derived from rows
ROOT_FIELD_TYPES.matrix_export_git_blob_sha: exact lowercase 40-hex Git blob SHA of SOURCE_ARTIFACTS.MATRIX_EXPORT

COVERAGE_ROW_TYPES.clause_id: exact clause_id from bound clause manifest
COVERAGE_ROW_TYPES.authority_disposition: exact disposition from bound clause manifest
COVERAGE_ROW_TYPES.mapped_source_entry_ids: sorted unique array of valid source_entry_id strings; empty allowed only for CONTEXT_NON_OBLIGATION

DERIVATION: For each BUILD_OBLIGATION clause, an independently reviewed coverage decision maps zero or more normalized matrix source_entry_ids whose pinned source paragraph/anchor/text provenance materially covers that clause. No authority-reconciliation result is consulted at this layer.
If one or more valid matrix source entries cover a BUILD_OBLIGATION clause, mapped_source_entry_ids is the sorted unique exact set and coverage_status=COVERED.

If no matrix source entry covers a BUILD_OBLIGATION clause, mapped_source_entry_ids contains exactly the deterministic PRIMARY_FINAL_DOC_C_OMISSION source_entry_id for that clause and coverage_status=COVERED.
coverage_status=UNMATCHED only when a BUILD_OBLIGATION clause has neither a reviewed valid matrix mapping nor a valid deterministic omission mapping.
Every mapped matrix ID must exist in MATRIX_SOURCE_SET; every mapped omission ID must equal the deterministic omission ID for the same clause. Any other ID is invalid and blocks the manifest.
FINAL_DOC_C_COVERAGE_MANIFEST.ORDER: rows sort by clause_id UTF-8 bytes

DEPENDENCY_MODEL.ACYCLIC_RULE: Coverage depends only on the bound final-DOC-C clause manifest, the exact pinned matrix export identity/normalized matrix source IDs, deterministic omission-ID rules, and independently reviewed coverage decisions. It MUST NOT depend on SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH, AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH, active/deployment roots, or mutable implementation evidence.
DEPENDENCY_MODEL.MATRIX_SOURCE_SET: The candidate matrix source-entry set is exactly the 837 normalized matrix IDs obtained under MATRIX_NORMALIZATION from matrix_export_git_blob_sha.
DEPENDENCY_MODEL.OMISSION_SOURCE_SET: Candidate omission IDs are deterministically derivable from BUILD_OBLIGATION clause_id values under IDENTITY_CONSTRUCTION.PRIMARY_OMISSION_SOURCE_ENTRY_ID.

CONSISTENCY: authority_disposition exactly equals the bound clause-manifest row disposition for clause_id.
Every bound clause_id appears exactly once and no foreign clause_id appears.
row_count equals bound clause-manifest clause_count and rows.length.
mapped_source_entry_ids are unique and sorted by UTF-8 bytes.
CONTEXT_NON_OBLIGATION cannot map any source entry.
BUILD_OBLIGATION cannot be COVERED by an empty mapping.

ROOT_FIELD_TYPES.entry_count: non-negative integer equal entries.length and matrix_entry_count + primary_omission_entry_count
ROOT_FIELD_TYPES.primary_final_doc_c_coverage_unmatched_c: non-negative integer exactly equal bound coverage-manifest unmatched_count

MATRIX_ENTRY_TYPES.source_entry_id: non-empty NFC string equal normalized matrix ID cell

OMISSION_ENTRY_TYPES.clause_id: exact clause_id from bound clause manifest
OMISSION_ENTRY_TYPES.primary_docx_refs_1_based: nonempty sorted unique array of PRIMARY_REF with doc_class=DOC_C
OMISSION_ENTRY_TYPES.normalization_evidence_refs: nonempty sorted unique array of CONTROL_EVIDENCE_REF

INCLUSION: All 837 Build Matrix rows exactly once.
Exactly one omission row for every BUILD_OBLIGATION clause not covered by a matrix source entry.
No omission row for CONTEXT_NON_OBLIGATION clauses.
Every source_entry_id unique across matrix and omission rows.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.ORDER: entries sort by source_entry_id UTF-8 bytes
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.EXTRA_KEYS: FORBIDDEN in root and entry projections
ACTIVATION_GATES: bound clause and coverage manifests independently reviewed PASS
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.FORBIDDEN_SHORTCUT: Source enumeration is evidence of source coverage only and is never itself the active-build denominator.

ROOT_FIELD_TYPES.entry_count: non-negative integer equal bound source-enumeration entry_count and entries.length

ENTRY_TYPES.source_entry_id: exact source_entry_id from bound source enumeration
ENTRY_TYPES.final_doc_c_normative_refs_1_based: sorted unique array of PRIMARY_REF restricted to DOC_C
ENTRY_TYPES.supporting_doc_b_refs_1_based: sorted unique array of PRIMARY_REF restricted to DOC_B
ENTRY_TYPES.supporting_doc_d_refs_1_based: sorted unique array of PRIMARY_REF restricted to DOC_D
ENTRY_TYPES.deployment_doc_e_refs_1_based: sorted unique array of PRIMARY_REF restricted to DOC_E

DECISION_INVARIANTS: DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_ONLY => polarity=NOT_APPLICABLE for build and deployment_doc_e_refs_1_based nonempty.
All other non-conflict/non-unknown decisions => polarity=NOT_APPLICABLE for active-build denominator.
CONFLICT or UNKNOWN blocks root activation through unresolved_count.
DOC-B and DOC-D references never independently authorize an active decision.
Historical/pre-FINAL source entries cannot be active without nonempty final DOC-C refs.
COMPLETENESS: source_entry_id sets are exactly identical to bound source enumeration.
exactly one reconciliation row per source_entry_id.
unresolved_count mechanically equals CONFLICT|UNKNOWN row count.
every ACTIVE final DOC-C ref resolves to a BUILD_OBLIGATION clause in the bound clause manifest.
every PRIMARY_FINAL_DOC_C_OMISSION source entry reconciles ACTIVE with polarity matching its clause manifest.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.ORDER: entries sort by source_entry_id UTF-8 bytes
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.EXTRA_KEYS: FORBIDDEN in root and entry projections

DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_MANIFEST.PURPOSE: Remove free-text/NLP dependency inference from active denominator construction.

ROOT_FIELD_TYPES.row_count: non-negative integer equal active reconciliation row count and rows.length

ROW_TYPES.dependency_source_entry_ids: sorted unique array of source_entry_id strings present in source enumeration
ROW_TYPES.unresolved_dependency_tokens: sorted unique array of non-empty NFC strings

DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_MANIFEST.DERIVATION_AUTHORITY: Dependency resolution is a reviewed engineering interpretation over pinned sources. The accepted manifest generation is the canonical decision; active-root generation never re-parses free text itself.
DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_MANIFEST.UNRESOLVED_RULE: unresolved_count = total number of rows with unresolved_dependency_tokens.length > 0
DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_MANIFEST.ORDER: rows sort by source_entry_id UTF-8 bytes
DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION_MANIFEST.ACTIVATION_GATE: unresolved_count == 0 and exactly one row for every active reconciliation source_entry_id

VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_MANIFEST.PURPOSE: Bind one reviewed immutable acceptance-criteria set instead of permitting projector paraphrase freedom.

ROW_TYPES.source_entry_id: source_entry_id present in bound source enumeration

COVERAGE: Exactly one ACTIVE_BUILD row for every active reconciliation source_entry_id.
Exactly one DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE row for every deployment-evidence reconciliation source_entry_id.
No rows for other reconciliation decisions.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_MANIFEST.CRITERION_TEXT_RULE: Criterion text may be an exact source statement or a reviewed derived acceptance statement. It becomes authoritative only through this exact manifest generation and independent review; denominator generation must copy it byte-for-byte after NFC and may not paraphrase.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_MANIFEST.ORDER: rows sort by scope UTF-8 bytes then source_entry_id UTF-8 bytes
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_MANIFEST.CRITERIA_ORDER_RULE: For each row, criteria are unique and sorted by criterion_id UTF-8 bytes after recomputing every criterion_id from the exact row/root context. Array authoring order has no authority.
